messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] P1 - Elevated 5xx rates and timeouts observed in EU and APAC economy tier since 2790012300. Error spike correlates with sudden traffic surge to economy routing policy. Automated throttles triggered; some customers seeing 503s and long tail latencies. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/traffic/economy-lane?orgId=1 :rotating_light:
Alex (oncall): acked — I'm on it. Priya, can you take lead? paging Priya SRE :phone:
Priya SRE: on it. looking at KPIs now. initial ask: do we want immediate mitigations (disable economy lane in regions / regional weight shift / per-customer caps) or try rate caps first? any high-priority customers impacted?
Megan (support): AcmeCo and BrightRetail reporting 503s in EU-WEST and APAC. AcmeCo has live customers; they've sent an INC. Support has posted details in the customer channel.
Priya SRE: thanks Megan. immediate plan: 1) steer new traffic away from economy lane in eu-west and apac-regions by setting regional weight to 0 for economy-policy, 2) apply temporary per-customer soft caps to prevent retries from overwhelming standard lanes, 3) disable experimental reranker on economy to reduce load. This is an emergency change — low-risk route is regional weight shift + quota.
Steve (eng-runtime): caution that moving 100% traffic at once will increase standard-lane CPU/GPU usage. recommend a quick staged weight shift: eu-west: economy weight 100 -> 25 -> 10 -> 0 over 3 steps with short pause and monitoring. also set a global per-customer cap of 50rps for economy-originated sessions to prevent thundering herds.
Priya SRE: agreed. I'll perform a staged change. prepping the API payload now.
Priya SRE: executing step 1 (eu-west -> 25%). command:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.example/api/v1/smart-routing/policies/economy/regions/eu-west" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"weight":25, "reason":"emergency-steer-eu-apac-surge-2790012345"}'
```
Steve (eng-runtime): also flip off the economy reranker feature flag for eu and apac to reduce model load: feature flag key = feature.economy.rerank.enabled, set false for scoped regions. Example payload below.
```json
{"flag":"feature.economy.rerank.enabled","scope":["eu-west","apac-sg"],"value":false}
```
Carlos (ops): running Priya's curl now. returning: 200 OK. policy update accepted.
Carlos (ops): applying per-customer soft cap rule (50 rps) on economy-originated sessions via rate-limiter service:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.example/api/v1/rate-limits" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"scope":"economy-origin","type":"soft","limit_rps":50,"regions":["eu-west","apac-sg"],"ttl_seconds":3600}'
```
Carlos (ops): response 200. rule ID 9f72-ae3 applied.
incident-bot: Metric update: eu-west 5xx rate dropped from 11.2% to 4.1% within 90s of first weight shift. APAC shows a 58% reduction as well. Latency for standard lane increased ~18ms p50. https://grafana.redwood.example/d/traffic/economy-lane?orgId=1
Megan (support): AcmeCo confirmed degraded calls stopped after 2m; they asked what changed (they want postmortem).
Jamie (product): quick Q—did we disable any fallbacks that would affect output quality? we need to keep customers informed of potential latency vs cost tradeoffs.
Priya SRE: we only disabled the economy reranker flag (low-quality reranking), which may slightly change scores but avoids extra model calls. Standard-tier generation unchanged. We'll document the tradeoff for customers.
Steve (eng-runtime): one more mitigation we applied: temporarily increased standard-lane burst capacity by +2 instances in eu-west to handle delta (autoscaler bypassed for emergency). That required a small infra burst, now stable.
Carlos (ops): infra scale confirmed, new instances up in 45s.
Alex (oncall): good. Priya, what's the hypothesis for the root cause?
Priya SRE: preliminary: a misconfigured public crawler/service generated many short-lived sessions targeting the economy routing key (we use economy as default in some client SDKs). No model errors observed — it's request-level load. We see correlated spikes from a narrow set of IP ranges and an unusual user-agent pattern. suspect default-quota too permissive for new keys.
Lindsay (sec): I'm pulling the IPs and will add a temporary WAF rule and request rate-limit at edge. please share the list.
Priya SRE: shared IP list in ops-sec channel. Lindsay, any ETA?
Lindsay (sec): WAF rule pushed to block the top 5 offending IPs; implemented rate-limit for remaining addresses. should see effect in next minute.
incident-bot: Security action logged. WAF rule ID wf-772 applied.
Priya SRE: metrics confirm additional drop after WAF: eu-west 5xx -> 1.3% now. Good window to start a cautious re-enable canary. Proposal: re-enable economy weight at 10% in eu-west, monitor 5m, then 25% if stable. No re-enable in APAC until we confirm.
Jamie (product): sounds reasonable. add customer communication explaining short-term tradeoff (slightly reduced quality for economy customers) and expected timeline.
Megan (support): drafting message to AcmeCo + BrightRetail stating we applied a routing mitigation and are investigating root cause. will include ETA for postmortem.
Carlos (ops): executing canary: set eu-west economy weight to 10%. API returned 200.
incident-bot: Canary update: eu-west economy at 10%. Monitoring window started.
Priya SRE: 5m monitor shows stable error at 1.5% and CPU on standard lane within safe range. canary looks good. hold 20m then consider 25%.
Alex (oncall): thanks team. can we list immediate follow-ups and owners?
Priya SRE: - Postmortem owner: Priya SRE (due EOD +2). - Remediation: tighten default quotas for new keys (owner: Steve), add automated regional circuit-breaker for economy (owner: Carlos), improve client SDK docs to avoid economy default (owner: Jamie).
Steve (eng-runtime): will open a ticket to change default quotas and add quota-enforcement tests (PR target next week).
Carlos (ops): I'll add a scheduler job to auto-detect sudden weight delta and preemptively cap per-customer retries.
Lindsay (sec): will follow up with a security note and include the blocked IP ranges; investigating whether this was malicious or misconfigured bot.
Megan (support): I'll send customer comms and collect any additional incidents.
Priya SRE: closing the page: current state — economy tier steered in eu-west to 10% (canary), disabled in APAC, reranker flag off for impacted regions, per-customer soft caps in place, WAF rules applied. System stable. If no regressions in next 30m, we'll mark resolved.
incident-bot: Incident status: resolved -> monitoring. Pager closed at 2790012800. :white_check_mark: All actions logged to incident issue INC-2790.
